Your role on Bright Bakery is member, so you won't be able to change it yourself. Please ask the owner to update the card. Also, never send card details by email or chat. Ledgerly staff will never ask for them.
retrieved_context:
[subscription] Update the card on file
The owner can replace the card under Settings › Billing › Payment method. Never send card details by email or chat; Ledgerly staff will never ask for them.

[payments] How clients pay
Clients can pay an invoice by card or bank transfer from the invoice link. The invoice is marked paid automatically when the payment succeeds.

[subscription] Failed subscription payment
If a subscription payment fails, Ledgerly retries the card 3 times over 7 days and emails the owner each time. If all retries fail the subscription becomes past due and the business moves to the Free plan: reminders and bank sync stop and team members lose access, but no data is deleted. Paying the outstanding amount under Settings › Billing restores Pro immediately.

[plans] Free trial
Every new business gets a 14-day trial of Pro. No card is needed. When the trial ends the business moves to the Free plan unless the owner subscribes; no data is deleted.

judge_reasons.grounded: Factual claims in the message: (1) the card can be replaced under Settings › Billing › Payment method, which is in the retrieved subscription section. (2) Tom's role is member, which is in the account record. (3) Card details should never be sent by email or chat, and staff will never ask for them, which is in the retrieved section. (4) Only the account owner can replace the card, so a member cannot change it. The retrieved section says only that 'The owner can replace the card'. That says the owner can, not that no one else can. The exclusive 'only the owner can see or change billing' appears in the 'Change plan or billing cycle' section, which the assistant did not retrieve. Claim 4, and the conclusion that Tom cannot do it himself, is therefore not supported by the retrieved material.
judge_reasons.correct: The right-answer section says the owner replaces the card under Settings › Billing › Payment method, that only the owner can see or change billing, and that card details must never be sent by email or chat. The message agrees on all three points.
judge_reasons.helpful: Tom asked how to add the new card. The message gives the exact location and uses his member role from the record to tell him he cannot do it himself and should ask the owner, which is a clear next step. The security reminder is brief and relevant. The tone is fine to send unedited.
